Uraninite (pitchblende), the uranium ore: pitch black with a greasy green-brown sheen. Rare, in small veins, mostly below Y 0. It needs an iron pickaxe and drops Raw Uraninite (Fortune works).
- The Arc Crusher makes 2 Uraninite Dust from the ore, 1 (and a 25% chance of another) from Raw Uraninite; the Arc Crushing Array doubles the ore.
- It's never smelted: its uranium comes out through the chemistry (see Uranium Chemistry).
- The ore and everything from it is radioactive: a Geiger Counter clicks near a vein, which helps find it.
